section.title: Quoting a currency conversion
section.scenario: A small business dashboard shows what an invoice would come to in the customer's currency, labeled as an estimate. The rate provider allows 1,000 calls a day on the current plan, the dashboard makes about 150 conversions on a busy day, and each call returns in under 100 ms. Nobody has reported the dashboard as slow.
section.question: Both pieces give the same estimate when the rate has not moved. Which cost should this system pay, and which stated facts decide it?
